name: Ripples
desc: Concentric ripple rings spreading on a dark water surface — raindrops and beat-driven splashes nucleate expanding rings that overlap and fade, over a slow glinting specular sheen like moonlight on the water; turns any scene into a reflection on a pond.

spread.doc: how far drops scatter across the frame

style.doc: moonlit=silver-blue on dark water / pond=grey daylight / ink=black water, white sumi rings / oil=iridescent oil-slick sheen
